units: Ḥull. 45ᵇ טַרְיֵיה לרישיה shook his head constantly; [Ar.: he bumped his head, shocked his brain]. Ib. 51ᵃ, v. טְרַח II.
<cite ref="Tamid 32b:12">Tam. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>ט׳ באפיה</he> sprinkled his face (with that water).

<cite ref="Shabbat 108b">Sabb. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>מהו למִטְרָא וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>למימשי</he>, Ms. O. <he>למישרא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8) is it permitted to drop some of this water into the eye?—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25:5">Lev. R. s. 25</cite> <he>יהי טָרֵי וכ׳</he> (not <he>טרו</he>) shall cast one fig in his face; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 2:20:1">Koh. R. to II, 20</cite> <he>יהא טריה</he> (read: <he>יהא טרי חד</he>).
<cite ref="Taanit 24a:17">Taan. 24ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>טַרְיוּהוּ מן גודא וכ׳</he> Ms. M. 2 (ed. <he>חבוטו</he>) throw him down from the elevation; a. fr.

senses.gloss: Trnsf. שקיל וטרי [to take up and throw back a ball &c.,] to hear and reply, to argue; to negotiate (corresp. to h. נשא ונתן).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ruth 4:7">Targ. Ruth IV, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 3:8">Targ. Cant. III, 8</cite> <he>יטַרְיָן</he> (not <he>וטירן</he>; ed. Lag. <he>וטָארָן</he>).—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 64a">B. Mets. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>דלא ש׳ וט׳ בהדיה</he> with whom he was not accustomed to deal.
<cite ref="Sotah 7b">Sot. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>למישקל ולמִיטְרָא וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ומטרח</he>, corr. acc.) to argue with &c.; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="I00727"><he>טָרוּן</he></cite>.
